pitfalls.expected_behavior: The official wav_list input reference enumerates mono, but DEE 5.2.1 XML runtime rejects the tested mono layout with missing required multichannel slot field errors such as file_name_C. Keep thd_wav_list_v1 narrowed away from mono while allowing stereo/5.1/7.1.
DEE 5.2.1 XML wav_list treats '-' as a literal filename and fails to mount it. Silent completion via '-' is a CLI behavior, not a supported XML wav_list input behavior.
